continents.dissolved_vertices.why: Vertex count of a union is an algorithm artifact: GeoFrame's union drops collinear and near-duplicate vertices (Antarctica 4660 vs 4923, Asia 12257 vs 12259, others equal); areas and hulls agree within 1e-6.

continents.country_vertices_simplified_5.why: Douglas-Peucker at 50 km leaves an invalid ring in VEN, USA, RUS, SAH, IDN and CAN; GEOS repairs it with buffer(0) and GeoFrame returns the raw rings (documented in docs/parity.md), so those countries differ by 2 vertices or fewer; the other 236 agree vertex for vertex.
